shots: Your workout routine is just too complicated.
You need simple options to make fitness easier like this vibration plate.
It adds daily movement without planning an entire workout.
You can adjust the vibration settings,
and it comes with stretching straps so you can get creative with how you use it. [PLACEHOLDER: strap shot from Grace]
This might be the home fitness upgrade you've been missing.
